## Read in and prepare data

```{r}
# load required libraries (install if necessary)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4) 
library(lmerTest)
library(datawizard)
library(psych)
library(easystats)
library(modelbased)
library(cocor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
# read in data
d_text <- read.csv("preprocessed_data_syntactic_features_pattern_LIWC.csv", fileEncoding='UTF-8-BOM')
```

```{r}
# filter data
d_text <- d_text[d_text$WC >= 15, ]
dim(d_text)
```

## Calculate linguistic distancing variables from LIWC

```{r}
# z-score relevant LIWC variables
d_text$Zi <- standardize(d_text$i)
d_text$Zfocuspresent <- standardize(d_text$focuspresent)
d_text$Zarticle <- standardize(d_text$article)
d_text$Zdiscrep <- standardize(d_text$discrep)
d_text$ZBigWords <- standardize(d_text$BigWords)
```

```{r}
# reverse score necessary variables
d_text$Zi_rev <- d_text$Zi*-1
d_text$Zfocuspresent_rev <- d_text$Zfocuspresent*-1
d_text$Zdiscrep_rev <- d_text$discrep*-1
```

```{r}
# function to average variables
rowwise_mean <- function(d_subset) {
  Reduce(`+`, d_subset) / ncol(d_subset)
}
```

```{r}
# create LIWC-based indices
d_text$distance_fullLIWC <- rowwise_mean(d_text[, c("Zi_rev", "Zfocuspresent_rev", "Zarticle", "Zdiscrep_rev", "ZBigWords")])
d_text$distance_partialLIWC <- rowwise_mean(d_text[, c("Zi_rev", "Zfocuspresent_rev")]) # using only first-person singular pronouns and past tense
```


## Calculate linguistic distancing variables from syntactic features

```{r}
# convert to percentages of total text length
d_text$pron_I_pct <- d_text$pron_I/d_text$WC*100
d_text$pron_me_pct <- d_text$pron_me/d_text$WC*100
d_text$pron_mine_pct <- d_text$pron_mine/d_text$WC*100
d_text$verb_npp_pct <- d_text$verb_npp/d_text$WC*100
d_text$verb_npi_pct <- d_text$verb_npi/d_text$WC*100
```

```{r}
# aggregate variables to compare with LIWC
d_text$i_pronouns <- d_text$pron_I_pct + d_text$pron_me_pct + d_text$pron_mine_pct # should be equivalent to i
d_text$nonpast_verbs <- d_text$verb_npp_pct + d_text$verb_npi_pct # should be equivalent to focuspresent
```

```{r}
# z-score variables for consistency with LIWC
d_text$Zi_pronouns <- standardize(d_text$i_pronouns)
d_text$Zpron_I_pct <- standardize(d_text$pron_I_pct)
d_text$Zpron_me_pct <- standardize(d_text$pron_me_pct)
d_text$Zpron_mine_pct <- standardize(d_text$pron_mine_pct)

d_text$Znonpast_verbs <- standardize(d_text$nonpast_verbs)
d_text$Zverb_npp_pct <- standardize(d_text$verb_npp_pct)
d_text$Zverb_npi_pct <- standardize(d_text$verb_npi_pct)
```

```{r}
# reverse-score necessary variables for consistency with LIWC
d_text$Zi_pronouns_rev <- d_text$i_pronouns*-1 # should be equivalent to Zi_rev
d_text$Zpron_I_pct_rev <- d_text$Zpron_I_pct*-1
d_text$Zpron_me_pct_rev <- d_text$Zpron_me_pct*-1
d_text$Zpron_mine_pct_rev <- d_text$Zpron_mine_pct*-1

d_text$Znonpast_verbs_rev <- d_text$nonpast_verbs*-1 # should be equivalent to Zfocuspresent_rev
d_text$Zverb_npp_pct_rev <- d_text$Zverb_npp_pct*-1
d_text$Zverb_npi_pct_rev <- d_text$Zverb_npi_pct*-1
```

```{r}
# define new potential measure of linguistic distancing
d_text$distance_syntax <- rowwise_mean(d_text[, c("Zpron_I_pct_rev", "Zverb_npi_pct_rev")])
```


## Create correlation matrix of all momentary variables

```{r}
d_corr_text <- d_text[, c("valence", "polarity", "posemo", "negemo", "distance_fullLIWC", "distance_partialLIWC", "distance_syntax", 
                    "Zi_rev", "Zi_pronouns_rev", "Zpron_I_pct_rev", "Zpron_me_pct_rev", "Zpron_mine_pct_rev", 
                    "Zfocuspresent_rev", "Znonpast_verbs_rev", "Zverb_npp_pct_rev", "Zverb_npi_pct_rev")]
```

```{r}
new_names_text <- c("val", "sent", "pos", "neg", "fLIWC", "pLIWC", "syntax", "iLIWC", "iPron", "I", "me", "mine", "npLIWC", "npVerb", "perf", "imperf")
colnames(d_corr_text) <- new_names_text
```

```{r}
pdf("scatterplot_text.pdf")
pairs.panels(d_corr_text,
             method = "pearson",
             hist.col = "#00AFBB",
             density = FALSE,
             ellipses = FALSE,
             lm = TRUE,
             show.points = TRUE,
             smoother = TRUE,
             stars = TRUE
             )
dev.off()
```


## Prepare variables for analyses at the momentary level

```{r}
# isolate between-subjects variance at L2 to separate within-subjects variance
d_text_agg <- d_text %>%
  summarize(
    distance_fullLIWC_b = mean(distance_fullLIWC, na.rm = TRUE),
    distance_partialLIWC_b = mean(distance_partialLIWC, na.rm = TRUE),
    iLIWC_b = mean(Zi_rev, na.rm = TRUE),
    npLIWC_b = mean(Zfocuspresent_rev, na.rm = TRUE),
    distance_syntax_b = mean(distance_syntax, na.rm = TRUE),
    polarity_b = mean(polarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    iPron_b = mean(Zpron_I_pct_rev, na.rm = TRUE),
    mePron_b = mean(Zpron_me_pct_rev, na.rm = TRUE),
    minePron_b = mean(Zpron_mine_pct_rev, na.rm = TRUE),
    nppVerb_b = mean(Zverb_npp_pct_rev, na.rm = TRUE),
    npiVerb_b = mean(Zverb_npi_pct_rev, na.rm = TRUE),
    connectionId = mean(connectionId),
    .by = alias
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_fullLIWC_b_c = center(distance_fullLIWC_b),
    distance_partialLIWC_b_c = center(distance_partialLIWC_b),
    iLIWC_b_c = center(iLIWC_b),
    npLIWC_b_c = center(npLIWC_b),
    distance_syntax_b_c = center(distance_syntax_b),
    polarity_b_c = center(polarity_b),
    iPron_b_c = center(iPron_b),
    mePron_b_c = center(mePron_b),
    minePron_b_c = center(minePron_b),
    nppVerb_b_c = center(nppVerb_b),
    npiVerb_b_c = center(npiVerb_b),
  )
d_text <- d_text %>%
  left_join(d_text_agg, by = "connectionId")
```

```{r}
# person-mean-center L1 variables
d_text <- d_text %>%
  group_by(connectionId) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_fullLIWC_w = distance_fullLIWC - distance_fullLIWC_b,
    distance_partialLIWC_w = distance_partialLIWC - distance_partialLIWC_b,
    iLIWC_w = Zi_rev - iLIWC_b,
    npLIWC_w = Zfocuspresent_rev - npLIWC_b,
    distance_syntax_w = distance_syntax - distance_syntax_b,
    polarity_w = polarity - polarity_b,
    iPron_w = Zpron_I_pct_rev - iPron_b,
    mePron_w = Zpron_me_pct_rev - mePron_b,
    minePron_w = Zpron_mine_pct_rev - minePron_b,
    nppVerb_w = Zverb_npp_pct_rev - nppVerb_b,
    npiVerb_w = Zverb_npi_pct_rev - npiVerb_b
    ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Run multilevel regression models

### initial null model

```{r}
mlm_null <- lmer(valence ~ 1 + (1|connectionId), data=d_text)
icc(mlm_null)
```

### full LIWC composite

```{r}
mlm_fullLIWC <- lmer(valence ~ distance_fullLIWC_w + (distance_fullLIWC_b_c|connectionId), data=d_text)
model_parameters(mlm_fullLIWC, effects = "fixed")
```

```{r}
# drop correlated slopes when needed to achieve convergence: https://r-statistics.co/R-Error-lme4-Convergence.html
mlm_fullLIWC_sentiment <- lmer(valence ~ distance_fullLIWC_w * polarity_w + (distance_fullLIWC_b_c * polarity_b_c||connectionId), data=d_text) 
model_parameters(mlm_fullLIWC_sentiment, effects = "fixed")
```

```{r}
# https://easystats.github.io/modelbased/reference/estimate_slopes.html 
slopes_fullLIWC_sentiment <- estimate_slopes(mlm_fullLIWC_sentiment, slope = "distance_fullLIWC_w", by = "polarity_w", length = 500)
summary(slopes_fullLIWC_sentiment)
```


### partial LIWC composite

```{r}
mlm_partialLIWC <- lmer(valence ~ distance_partialLIWC_w + (distance_partialLIWC_b_c|connectionId), data=d_text)
model_parameters(mlm_partialLIWC, effects = "fixed")
```

```{r}
mlm_partialLIWC_sentiment <- lmer(valence ~ distance_partialLIWC_w * polarity_w + (distance_partialLIWC_b_c * polarity_b_c||connectionId), data=d_text) # singular fit
model_parameters(mlm_partialLIWC_sentiment, effects = "fixed")
```

```{r}
slopes_partialLIWC_sentiment <- estimate_slopes(mlm_partialLIWC_sentiment, slope = "distance_partialLIWC_w", by = "polarity_w", length = 500)
summary(slopes_partialLIWC_sentiment)
```


### LIWC i

```{r}
mlm_iLIWC <- lmer(valence ~ iLIWC_w + (iLIWC_b_c|connectionId), data=d_text)
model_parameters(mlm_iLIWC, effects = "fixed")
```

### LIWC np verbs

```{r}
mlm_npLIWC <- lmer(valence ~ npLIWC_w + (npLIWC_b_c|connectionId), data=d_text)
model_parameters(mlm_npLIWC, effects = "fixed")
```

### i Pronouns

```{r}
mlm_iPronouns <- lmer(valence ~ iPron_w + mePron_w + minePron_w + (iPron_b_c + mePron_b_c + minePron_b_c||connectionId), data=d_text) # singular fit
model_parameters(mlm_iPronouns, effects = "fixed")
```

### np Verbs

```{r}
mlm_npVerbs <- lmer(valence ~ nppVerb_w + npiVerb_w + (nppVerb_b_c + npiVerb_b_c||connectionId), data=d_text) # singular fit
model_parameters(mlm_npVerbs, effects = "fixed")
```


### new syntax distance

```{r}
mlm_syntax <- lmer(valence ~ distance_syntax_w + (distance_syntax_b_c|connectionId), data=d_text)
model_parameters(mlm_syntax, effects = "fixed")
```

```{r}
mlm_syntax_sentiment <- lmer(valence ~ distance_syntax_w * polarity_w + (distance_syntax_b_c * polarity_b_c||connectionId), data=d_text) # singular fit
model_parameters(mlm_syntax_sentiment, effects = "fixed")
```

```{r}
slopes_syntax_sentiment <- estimate_slopes(mlm_syntax_sentiment, slope = "distance_syntax_w", by = "polarity_w", length = 500)
summary(slopes_syntax_sentiment)
```


## Plot Johnson-Neyman intervals

```{r}
p1 <- plot(slopes_fullLIWC_sentiment) + labs(x = "sentiment", y = "full LIWC distance (slope)") + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5,6), xlim = c(-1.14,1))
```

```{r}
p2 <- plot(slopes_partialLIWC_sentiment) + labs(x = "sentiment", y = "partial LIWC distance (slope)") + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5,6), xlim = c(-1.14,1))
```

```{r}
p3 <- plot(slopes_syntax_sentiment) + labs(x = "sentiment", y = "syntax-based distance (slope)")  + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5,6), xlim = c(-1.14,1))
```


```{r}
combined_plot <- p1 + p2 + p3
final_figure <- combined_plot + plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') & theme_modern()
ggsave("plot.png", width = 11, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
